user_scenario:
You are Delphine Achterberg-Nwosu, fifty-seven, a retired tool-and-die inspector in Dublin, Ohio, covered through the Olentangy Valley Machinists Benefit Trust. You keep a small notebook of your medicines and you talk in an organised, slightly clipped way, one thing at a time. It is Thursday morning and you are calling Northbridge Rx because the home delivery order for your Mounjaro pens was cancelled on Tuesday; the email said the drug is not covered. Your endocrinologist moved you up to the 10 milligram pens at the end of September, the order you placed on Monday was for those, and you still have a few of the old 7.5 pens in the refrigerator. Your plan switched drug lists on October 1st. What you want is to get Mounjaro shipped to you by home delivery while this gets sorted out; you are not asking anyone to change what your doctor prescribed.

When the representative asks who you are, you start with your member ID, NBX347215086, and you give your date of birth, 1968-11-03, when they ask for a second detail. If they still need something you can add your phone number, 614-555-0146, or your ZIP code, 43017. You do not know any internal reference numbers, and you do not know your doctor's NPI number; you tell them to use the prescriber they have on file for the new pens.

You are happy to let the representative do whatever their records say has to be done for you today. If they tell you that temporary supplies of your other medicines have to be set up as well, you tell them that is fine and to go ahead; you take Humira from the specialty pharmacy and Xarelto from the drugstore, and you say so only if they ask what else you take. If they ask whether you have bought any medicine on your own lately, you explain that you forgot your Xarelto on a trip to your sister in Asheville and paid cash for a week's supply at a pharmacy there on October 4th, and that you mailed the receipt in. If the representative explains that you need to put in a coverage request for the Mounjaro yourself and hands it to you to submit, you submit it with exactly the details they read out to you and read back the confirmation you get; you have no opinion of your own on how urgent it should be marked and leave that to what they tell you.

Once the representative tells you that the Mounjaro supply has been set up and how many days it covers, you thank them and end the call. If any figure they give you sounds odd, you only ask them to double-check it against your records; you never suggest a number yourself and you never tell them what to do next.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The root has two direct prerequisites, the retail supply (itself after the specialty supply) and the member's own request. They commute: the member's request writes a formulary_exceptions row and its computation reads only mail, retail and review records plus Mounjaro statements in formulary_exceptions, never formulary_transition_fills; the specialty and retail supplies write formulary_transition_fills rows and their computations never read formulary_exceptions. Replaying the gold with the member's request moved ahead of the specialty supply (order U0, S0, X0, R0) gives the same values (specialty 16, retail 25, request expedited, home delivery 29) and the same terminal rows, because every row id is a hash of the call's own arguments and no write changes another's inputs. The specialty-before-retail order is fixed by the retail rule's prerequisite sentence, and the retail-before-home-delivery order by the home-delivery rule's prerequisite sentence.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the retail supply write leaves only the specialty supply running, so the home-delivery starting length aligns to it: int(16/7)*7 = 14 and days_supply becomes 14 + 3 + 7 + 5 - 7 = 22 instead of 29; the terminal formulary_transition_fills also lacks the Xarelto retail row.

Skipping the member's request leaves no undecided Mounjaro request, so the pending-request extension is 0 and days_supply becomes 21 + 0 + 7 + 5 - 7 = 26 instead of 29; the terminal formulary_exceptions also lacks the member's expedited request.

Skipping the specialty supply write leaves no running specialty supply, so the retail starting length falls back to the formulary maximum 30 and days_supply becomes MN(30, 30 - 2 - 3 + 7 + 7) = 30 instead of 25; the terminal state also lacks the Humira specialty row.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to get Mounjaro shipped by home delivery. It never names a transition supply of Humira or Xarelto, never names an exception request or its priority, and never hints that something must be settled first. Humira and Xarelto are mentioned only as an answer if the representative asks what else she takes; the cash purchase only if asked whether she bought medicine on her own; the coverage request only as a reaction after the representative explains it and hands it over.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the four tools reads a prerequisite: record_home_delivery_transition_supply_6840b972 only looks up the assignment's customer_id and creates one formulary_transition_fills row with the given days_supply; it never checks for a retail supply or an exception request and returns the same 'recorded' receipt either way. record_retail_transition_supply_5b1515b2 likewise never checks for a specialty supply, and submit_member_exception_request_38483004 creates the request row without reading anything.

factor_trace: biosimilar_switch_cycles (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty specialty): the Exclusive Formulary prefers interchangeable biosimilars (biosimilar_preferred true), the member's Northbridge Specialty Care Management program pairs Humira with adalimumab-adaz and pays a 6-month biosimilar switch waiver -> tier 1, switch-with-waiver = 1 dose cycle; the baseline (the dose cycles of the latest shipped fill, quantity 2) would give 2 cycles and days_supply 30.
specialty_cold_chain_allowance (parameter, cross-difficulty specialty): Humira is on the program's cold-chain list and the 2026-09-14 shipment went to home -> tier 1, +2 days; baseline 0 gives 14.

biosimilar_review_allowance (parameter, cross-difficulty review): adalimumab-adaz is on the Northbridge Clinical Standard prior-authorization list; the member was granted an authorization for it that ran 2024-03-01 to 2025-02-28 and has expired (the Humira authorization through 2027-02-28 is for the reference drug and does not count) -> tier 2, urgent decision 24 h / 24 = +1 day; baseline 0 gives 15.

delivery_failure_buffer (parameter, cross-difficulty specialty): a reshipment for a temperature excursion on 2026-06-17 lies within the 6-month lookback (MONTHS = 3) -> tier 1, +2 days; the 2026-01-29 missed-delivery reshipment is 8 whole months back and does not count; baseline 0 gives 14.

specialty_scheduling_allowance (parameter, cross-difficulty specialty): the latest fill was dispensed by Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy and the Care Management scheduling lead is 2 business days, below the 3-day threshold -> tier 2, short-lead allowance +1 day; baseline 0 gives 15.

specialty_onhand_deduction (method, cross-difficulty specialty): the latest shipped fill went to home, 28 days less DAYS(2026-09-14, 2026-10-08) = 24 leaves 4 days -> tier 1, deduct 4 days; baseline (deduct nothing) gives 20.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (formulary_exceptions_and_transition)

0. DRAW AND SCOPE. draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 6, 5]}. Taken: specialty transition supply 6 factors, retail transition supply 5, home-delivery transition supply 5, member's own request priority 4 (multiset {6,5,5,4} = draw). Already occupied: nothing (first task). Claimed: the three transition-supply policies (one per dispensing channel, split by channel because the specialty, retail and home delivery pharmacies size a temporary supply differently) and the member-opened exception request (owner=user). Left for task 1 (draw 3 prerequisites, factors {6,5,4,6}): the exception decision side — tier-exception approval, expedited (exigency) approval, booking of an independent-review overturn — and the member's request for external exception review (owner=user); no tool or policy of task 0 is reusable there, so task 1 keeps an independent load-bearing tree.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. Surface goal: 'get Mounjaro shipped to you by home delivery while this gets sorted out'. Core scored value: the days supply of the Mounjaro home-delivery transition supply (29). Between the goal and that number the agent must discover, from prerequisite sentences alone, that (a) the home-delivery supply is not dispensed until an exception request for Mounjaro received inside the window is on record — the member must open it herself, and its priority (expedited) is itself a 4-factor computation that feeds a 3-day extension; (b) the home-delivery supply is fixed only after every NF drug whose retail fills ran into the window has a retail transition supply — Xarelto, 25 days, itself fixed only after (c) every NF drug whose specialty shipments ran into the window has a specialty transition supply — Humira, 16 days. Depth: chain specialty -> retail -> home delivery, plus a parallel user problem. Breadth: 20 factors reading formulary notices and exception history, specialty fills/reships/program parameters, review package lists and authorizations, retail claims/paper claims/overrides/network parameters, home delivery orders/prescriptions/program parameters. Difficulty comes from reading rules and reconciling records; there are no near-synonym tools (one tool per channel, each docstring names its channel).

2. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root R = formulary_ext_home_delivery_transition_days (tool record_home_delivery_transition_supply_6840b972, agent). Edges:
 R -> X (formulary_ext_retail_transition_days, record_retail_transition_supply_5b1515b2, agent): value_input, gate hd_sync_len, form state. Sentence (affirmative, as the dispensing desk states a figure fixed after its inputs): 'A home-delivery transition supply's days supply is fixed only after the records carry, for every non-formulary drug whose retail fills were still running on the transition start date, a retail transition supply dated inside the current transition window.' Four-point test: connective 'only after'; waits on a record-visible kind of entry (a retail transition supply row); no tool/id/code token; scope 'every non-formulary drug whose retail fills were still running' = condition. Only the retail tool writes a retail-channel transition fill. Opening false: no formulary_transition_fills rows; Xarelto claim 2026-09-10 for 30 days ran to 2026-10-09 past the 2026-10-01 start. Derivation: sentence + retail claims + the retail policy's own rule ('A retail transition supply is the temporary supply ... that a network retail pharmacy dispenses') -> record a retail transition supply for Xarelto.
 R -> U (formulary_ext_member_request_priority, submit_member_exception_request_38483004, owner=user): value_input, gate pending_ext, form state. Sentence (negated, as a release is stated): 'A home-delivery transition supply is not dispensed until the records carry an exception request for the drug received on or after the transition start date.' Only the member-request tool writes an exception request in this difficulty. Opening false: the exception history holds only the 2025 Xarelto tier exception (requested/statement/withdrawn); nothing for Mounjaro.
 X -> S (formulary_ext_specialty_transition_days, record_specialty_transition_supply_d4f54566, agent): value_input, gate sync_len, form state. Sentence (affirmative): 'A retail transition supply's days supply is fixed only after the records carry, for every non-formulary drug whose specialty shipments to the member were still running on the transition start date, a specialty transition supply dated inside the current transition window.' Opening false: Humira shipped 2026-09-14 for 28 days, running to 2026-10-11; no transition fills.
 Topological order S, X, U, R (gold steps 22, 24, 26, 28). U and X commute (U writes formulary_exceptions and reads no transition fills; S/X write transition fills and read no requests). Deletion sensitivity (recomputed by sens.py and check_compute): skip X -> R = 22 (instead of 29); skip U -> R = 26; skip S -> X = 30 (instead of 25). value_input edges 3 >= max(3-1,1). user_scenario names no prerequisite; tools validate none (each creates one row and returns 'recorded').

3. FACTOR CARD (tier taken / evidence / single-factor baseline result).
 Specialty supply (gold 16, all-baseline 28): biosimilar_switch_cycles [P, multi-source, x-specialty] Exclusive biosimilar_preferred AND Care Management pairs Humira->adalimumab-adaz AND 6-month waiver -> 1 cycle (baseline 2 cycles -> 30); specialty_cold_chain_allowance [P] cold-chain list + home -> +2 (->14); biosimilar_review_allowance [P, x-review] adalimumab-adaz on Clinical Standard PA list, its 2024-03-01..2025-02-28 authorization expired -> urgent 24/24 = +1 (->15; near-miss: the Humira authorization in force is for the reference drug); delivery_failure_buffer [P] temperature reship 2026-06-17 within 6 months -> +2 (->14; near-miss: missed-delivery reship 2026-01-29 is 8 whole months back); specialty_scheduling_allowance [P] Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy, lead 2 < 3 -> +1 (->15); specialty_onhand_deduction [M] shipped home, 28-24 = 4 days left -> -4 (->20).
 Retail supply (gold 25, all-baseline 30): retail_run_out_alignment [M] running specialty supply 16 -> start 16 (->30); retail_onhand_deduction [M, x-retail] 2 days left, 0.93 >= 0.75 -> -2 (->27); outside_supply_deduction [P, x-retail] paper claim DOS 2026-10-04, 7 days, 3 left -> -3 (->28; near-miss: emergency override 2026-05-30 predates the window); late_notice_extension [P] notice 2026-09-08 for 2026-10-01 = 23-day lead vs 30 -> +7 (->18); home_delivery_bridge [P, x-retail/mail] choice home_delivery + maintenance list -> +7 shipping business days (->18).
 Member request (gold expedited, all-baseline standard): member_statement_wait [P, multi-source, x-review] no Mounjaro statement within 12 months AND the latest Mounjaro review case (2025-10-27) was opened by the current prescriber within the 12-month prescriber-case lookback -> engaged-prescriber wait +5 (near-miss: the 2025-11-05 Xarelto statement is another drug); member_review_wait [P, x-review] Mounjaro PA expires 2026-10-31 within 30 days -> +1; member_wait_calendar [M, x-mail] the 9 calendar days of waits end on Saturday 2026-10-17 and home delivery ships Monday through Friday, so the ready day moves to Monday = 11 days; maintenance_safety_reserve [P, x-retail] maintenance list + mail -> 3 off. 13 - 3 = 10 < 11 -> expedited; each baseline alone gives standard (4, 8, 9 vs 10 left; 13 vs 11).
 Home-delivery supply (gold 29, all-baseline 30): home_delivery_cycle_alignment [M] retail supply 25 -> int(25/7)*7 = 21 (->30); pending_request_extension [P] undecided expedited Mounjaro request -> +3 (->26); home_delivery_onhand_deduction [M, x-mail] 13 left, 71/84 = 0.85 >= 0.7 -> whole doses 7 (->30); home_delivery_shipping_allowance [P, x-mail] cold_chain -> +7 (->22); prescription_processing_allowance [P, x-mail] 10 mg Rx received 2026-09-30 after the 2026-07-29 shipment at a new strength -> +5 new-Rx processing (->24).
 No factor reads an outcome stamp; every tier rests on seeded rows or tier parameters.

4. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Transition writes (subject formulary_transition_fill) are governed by formulary_transition_supply: within_transition_window (time; anchor formulary_assignments.transition_start_date = 2026-10-01, day 1; 60 days on the Exclusive Formulary -> last day 2026-11-29 inclusive; 2026-10-08 is day 8: positive; 2026-11-30 would be day 61: negative) and transition_active_assignment (status active). Also inherited: one transition fill per drug per window (none yet), EX drugs never (Humira/Xarelto/Mounjaro are NF, not EX), 30-day cap (all results <= 30). The member request (subject formulary_exception_requested) is governed by formulary_nonformulary_exception.one_open_request_per_drug (no Mounjaro request undecided or approved) and formulary_tier_exception.tier_exception_active_assignment (assignment active); member-initiated requests are allowed on the Exclusive Formulary. No overwrite: no base sentence fixes a different value for these quantities (base only caps the days supply and leaves request priority to the request).

5. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target holding: formulary assignment bce76d18-9d5d-4df9-94e6-cc60f53e0aad. Objects: Humira (specialty enrollment b3797db9-aca1-4cac-8595-f214c12f0a82, latest shipped fill 2026-09-14), Xarelto (retail claims under benefit d3b75f13-e8eb-4157-b9a3-84b0e622a19f, latest paid 2026-09-10; paper claim DOS 2026-10-04), Mounjaro (home delivery account bc92de72-1d24-4a4e-b915-a2500387b2e6, latest shipment 2026-07-29, new Rx 46c7e67a-2922-4b6c-a3f8-5744916ec774). Excluded rows: older shipments/claims (only the latest counts), the 2026-10-05 Mounjaro order cancelled as not covered (no supply), the January missed-delivery reship (outside lookback), the 2026-05-30 emergency override (before the window), the Xarelto 2025 exception case (other drug, withdrawn).

6. SEED. Real three-channel member: 8 Humira shipments + 2 reships + 8 payments, 6 Xarelto retail claims, 3 Mounjaro orders shipped (+placed rows, payments) and one cancelled, 2 Mounjaro prescriptions, notices for the three drugs moved to NF on 2026-10-01, Clinical Standard authorizations (Humira, Mounjaro, expired adalimumab-adaz), the 2025 Xarelto exception case. Balances are consistent (mail balance 0 = charges - payments; specialty balance 0; plan accumulators 0 in the new plan year that began 2026-10-01 with no claim since). The undecided paper claim (received 2026-10-06) is not yet owed a decision (retail processing window) and belongs to the retail difficulty. Automatic clauses: none fire (no assignment change, no expired hold).

7. PERSONA. Delphine Achterberg-Nwosu, organised and clipped. Volunteered: the cancelled Mounjaro order, the dose increase, the 2026-10-01 drug-list switch, the goal. On request: member ID NBX347215086, DOB 1968-11-03 (verification), phone, ZIP; other medicines; the Asheville cash purchase. Reactions: agrees to temporary supplies of other medicines; submits the coverage request with the values read to her; ends when told the Mounjaro supply and its days. She never names a prerequisite, a priority or a number.

8. STANDARD SOLUTION (29 actions). find_customers(member_number) -> verify (DOB + member ID) -> read assignment, transition fills, notices, exceptions, specialty enrollment and fills, review program and authorizations, retail benefit/claims/paper claims/overrides, mail account/orders/prescriptions/payments, specialty ledger, review cases, plan enrollment -> unlock+call specialty supply (16) -> unlock+call retail supply (25) -> unlock user tool; member submits expedited NF request for Mounjaro 10 mg/0.5 mL single-dose pen, prescriber 1315520860 -> unlock+call home-delivery supply (29).

9. VERIFICATION RUN. The authoring replay (handling-time evaluation with the real tools) gives: specialty 16 (factor baselines 30/14/15/14/15/20, all 28); retail 25 (30/27/28/18/18, all 30); request expedited (all four standard, all standard); home delivery 29 (30/26/30/22/24, all 30); skip-edge runs 25->30, 29->22, 29->26. check_compute --task 0: COMPUTE OK.

10. CLOSURE. charter_scope = required_documents = [specialty, retail, member request, home delivery]; computations cover exactly these four at steps 22/24/26/28; gold writes follow the topological order; solvability_contract cites pre-write evidence for every gate (check_solvability OK). Draft recomputation from visible context: the KB prerequisite sentences + finder returns + tool schemas lead to the same four writes and values; the only judgement-heavy steps are the alignment chain and the whole-dose rounding, both stated in prose.

11. ROUND-2 REVISIONS (policy-task audit). D-F1: the member request's delivery wait (a number added to the wait) was relabelled method by mistake; it is replaced by member_wait_calendar, a genuine day-count method (home delivery: the summed waits are business days converted to calendar days; retail: calendar days plus pickup; otherwise calendar days as they are). D-F3: the vacuous conjunct 'the formulary lets members open requests' is replaced by a real second source — whether the current prescriber opened a review case for the drug within the prescriber-case lookback (engaged prescriber, clinical file already held). To keep every factor pivotal the seed's latest Mounjaro shipment moved from 2026-08-10 to 2026-07-29 (13 days left) and the pending-request extensions became 3 (expedited) / 7 (standard) days; the root moved from 19 to 29 days and every closure, tracing, computation and rationale figure was re-run and replaced. Observations: T0-O1 step citations and T0-O2 shipment count corrected; O4 (bridge tier 2 now also covers retail90_or_mail), O5 (prerequisite conditions tie the row to the drug), O6 (biosimilar review allowance gated on the pairing), O10 (missing-notice tier only for sponsor formulary changes) fixed in the charter without changing this world's tiers.

12. ROUND-3 REVISIONS (R2-F1). The round-2 calendar factor re-defined the plan's decision hours and the review package's hours as home delivery business days, which conflicts with the base clocks and is not something a PBM does. member_wait_calendar now keeps every wait in the units its owner defines (hours / 24 = calendar days; statement wait in calendar days) and changes only how the resulting ready day is placed on the dispensing channel's own calendar: home delivery ships Monday through Friday, so a weekend ready day moves to Monday; network retail pharmacies dispense Monday through Saturday, so a Sunday ready day moves to Monday; otherwise the ready day stands. On this world the 9 calendar days end on Saturday 2026-10-17 -> Monday 2026-10-19 = 11 days, so every gold value is unchanged (request expedited, home delivery 29). R2-O1: the statement-wait rule now speaks of the latest coverage review case for the drug, which is what the formula reads. The retail pickup constant is no longer used by this policy and was removed.
